turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who decided my son gets a zero, and why did he find out on his phone in the middle of class?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
You didn't answer my question. Who entered the zero, and did anyone talk to Owen first?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.
A machine's guess, and your own procedure 4.3 says software alone doesn't establish anything. What else do you have, Hale?
That's very high. The software is quite reliable.

"Quite reliable." Fourteen detection tools were tested in 2023 and found neither accurate nor reliable, and I have that printed in my bag. Is there anything you can actually put in front of me, or am I going to the principal?
So I had to give him a zero.
"Had to." So the software decided, you entered it, and nobody picked up a phone to call me, which is exactly what procedure 4.2 says you do first. I'm writing that down.
I hope you understand my position.
Your position is a percentage and a zero. Show me Owen's work, or I'm upstairs before my call.
